units.source_text: 帘内众女子，都不省得浮舟真心不欲使外人知道她还意外地活在世间，

en.t: The women behind the curtain did not understand that Ukifune truly did not want outsiders to know she was still unexpectedly alive in the world,

units.source_text: 又回想过去，觉得这男子和已故的小姐一样可惜可恋，

en.t: and thinking back on the past, they felt this man was as pitiable and dear as the late young lady,

units.source_text: 便对浮舟说道：“今天偶尔逢此机会，和这中将说几句话，决不会有意外的后患。

en.t: so they said to Ukifune, "Since this chance has come today, speaking a few words with this lieutenant will surely bring no unexpected trouble afterward.

units.source_text: 你可全然不动风情之念，只作知情识趣的样子，讲几句普通应酬话就是了。”

en.t: You need not feel the slightest romantic feeling; simply act as though you understand the situation and exchange a few ordinary courteous words."

units.source_text: 她们想打动浮舟的心。

en.t: They were trying to move Ukifune's heart.

units.source_text: 这些女子虽然当了尼姑，毕竟没有老成持重之心，

en.t: Although these women had become nuns, they still lacked a mature and steady heart,

units.source_text: 都爱好时髦，有时还唱唱粗劣的恋歌，装作少女模样。

en.t: and they all liked fashionable things, sometimes singing crude love songs and pretending to be young girls.

units.source_text: 因此浮舟很担心，深恐她们会放进那男子来。

en.t: For that reason Ukifune was very anxious, deeply afraid that they might let the man in.

units.source_text: 她想：“我已命里注定是个最苦恼的人，

en.t: She thought, "I have already been fated to be the most tormented of people,

units.source_text: 又不幸而苟延残喘，将来会沦落到什么地步呢！

en.t: and now, unfortunately, I have gone on barely living; to what depths will I fall in the future!

units.source_text: 我但愿别人都看不见我，听不到我，完全把我遗弃吧。”

en.t: I only wish that no one could see me or hear me, and that everyone would abandon me completely."

units.source_text: 她便倒身横卧着。

en.t: Then she let herself fall down and lay on her side.

units.source_text: 那中将大约另有伤心之事，沉痛地叹息，低声地吹笛，

en.t: That lieutenant seemed to have some other sorrow of his own; he sighed deeply and played the flute in a low tone,

units.source_text: 又独吟“鹿鸣凄戚”之歌，确是很有风趣的人。

en.t: and he also chanted alone the song of "the deer's mournful cry," showing himself to be a truly refined man.

units.source_text: 后来恨恨地说：“我因思念故人而来此，却不道来了反而伤心。

en.t: Later he said resentfully, "I came here because I longed for the one who is gone, but I never thought coming would only make me sadder.

units.source_text: 今已无法找到可慰我情的新欢，可知这里不是‘无忧山路’！”

en.t: Now that I cannot find a new love to comfort my heart, I see that this place is no 'mountain road free of sorrow'!"

units.source_text: 说罢就想回去。

en.t: After saying this, he meant to go back.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧说：“何不在此欣赏这‘良宵花月’？”

en.t: The younger nun said, "Why not stay here and enjoy this 'fine night, flowers, and moon'?"

units.source_text: 便膝行而出。

en.t: Then she came out, moving forward on her knees.

units.source_text: 中将没精打采地答道：“有什么可欣赏呢？

en.t: The lieutenant answered listlessly, "What is there to enjoy?

units.source_text: 我知道这里不是可慰我情的地方。”

en.t: I know this is not a place that can comfort my heart."

units.source_text: 他想：“过分留恋女色，毕竟不成体统。

en.t: He thought, "Being too attached to women is, after all, unseemly.

units.source_text: 我只是因为曾经瞥见那女子的姿态，想借此慰我悼亡之情。

en.t: It is only because I once glimpsed that woman's figure that I wanted to use this to soothe my grief for the dead.

units.source_text: 但这女子过分拒远我，好像是深闺里的千金小姐，

en.t: But this woman keeps me far too distant, as though she were a noble young lady shut deep within her chambers,

units.source_text: 和这草庵生涯甚不相称，也很乏味。”

en.t: which fits this life in a thatched hermitage very poorly, and is quite tedious as well."

units.source_text: 就准备回去。

en.t: So he prepared to leave.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧十分惋惜，想起他的笛声也觉得可恋，

en.t: The younger nun was deeply sorry to see him go, and even when she thought of the sound of his flute, she found it dear,

units.source_text: 便赠诗曰：

en.t: so she sent him a poem, saying:
